column1: # FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, Hong Kong release, update 1.0.1.
# Baseline at the game's native 30 fps. DM_FPS_TARGET=60 is available for
# separate validation; the two console variable addresses were remeasured.
# NPDM system resource: 20 MiB. nninitStartup parses this MB argument and
# caps it below 4096 before reserving the engine region. SDK build 0023a1b0
# receives its existing build-gated 62 MiB node-area reduction.
# The regional renderer uses the same NVN/Unreal shader archive format.
# Shader tables must be generated from this release's own archives; no
# shader identity or coverage is inferred from the other-region profile.
